candidates.change_summary: Change the returned version string from "1.0.0" to "1.0.1".
candidates.mutated_unit_code: function version() external pure returns (string memory) { return "1.0.1"; }

candidates.change_summary: Remove the statement `number = _number;` so the `number` state variable is never updated by setL1BlockValues.
Replace `number = _number;` with `number = _timestamp;` so the `number` state variable is set to the timestamp value instead.
Set timestamp to _number instead of _timestamp so the stored timestamp differs after a call with _number != _timestamp.
Remove the assignment to timestamp so it stays zero after any setL1BlockValues call.
Remove the require check so any caller can set L1 block values, allowing non-depositors to change basefee.
Replace the assignment to hash with a constant so it no longer stores the input value.
Delete the assignment to hash so the variable retains its previous value after setL1BlockValues.
Assign batcherHash's input to hash instead of _hash.
Delete the statement that assigns sequenceNumber, so it retains its old value after setL1BlockValues.
Replace the assignment to sequenceNumber with sequenceNumber = _number, so it stores the block number instead of the sequence number.
Remove the onlyDepositor modifier from setL1BlockValues so any caller can set sequenceNumber to arbitrary values.
